status_note: Demonstrated, never Validated. Every number here is computed from public NTD filings; there is no holdout, no counterfactual and no operator has confirmed any of it against their own books. A finding that survives this gate is a well-measured description of what agencies FILED, which is not the same as what happened.

panel.universe: US National Transit Database demand-response reporters
panel.mode_note: NTD encodes demand-response taxi and TNC service as Mode=DR with Type-of-Service TX/TN rather than a separate DT mode code; this file contains zero rows with Mode=='DT', so filtering Mode=='DR' retains them

external_constants.cpi: BLS CPI-U, US city average, all items, annual average (series CUUR0000SA0)

gate.note: A finding missing any required check is rejected for that reason alone -- silence is not a pass.

not_computable: Deadhead for any mode other than demand response, and deadhead as a time series: the only multi-year mode-tagged source we hold carries Vehicle Revenue Hours/Miles but no total (actual) hours, so there is no deadhead numerator in it. Every deadhead figure here is a 2024 cross-section.

Trip-level anything: wait times, on-time performance, denials, no-shows, ride durations, shared-ride factors. NTD is an annual and monthly aggregate return. No claim about individual rider experience can be made from these bytes.
Cause. Every finding here is a description of a filed number moving. Nothing in this panel identifies why it moved.

checks.detail: computed directly on Mode=='DR' rows of the mode-tagged monthly file; agrees with the mode-tagged DR total for 100.0% of 373 agencies (floor 95%)

MECHANICALLY COUPLED, not a finding. Recovery is UPT24/UPT19 and the productivity ratio is (UPT24/VRH24)/(UPT19/VRH19) -- the same two UPT terms appear in both, in the same direction, so a positive Spearman (+0.426) is guaranteed by the arithmetic before any operator does anything. The variable that is actually free is the hours change, which ranks against recovery at +0.803. Quoting the +0.43 as a causal result to anyone who has built an NTD panel would be a very short conversation
